intro: Tirion Fordring is a legendary paladin and former lord of Mardenholde Keep, now living in quiet exile in the Eastern Plaguelands. A paladin of the Knights of the Silver Hand, he was stripped of his title and lands for honoring a debt of honor to an enemy orc. From his modest cabin along the Thondroril River, he watches over the tragedy unfolding across Lordaeron and worries for his son.

sections.t: A Knight of the Silver Hand
p: Before the ruin of Lordaeron, Tirion Fordring was renowned as one of the kingdom's finest knights. A paladin of the Knights of the Silver Hand, the order Archbishop Alonsus Faol founded during the Second War, Tirion fought the Old Horde with plate, hammer, and holy devotion. He was revered as an unyielding paragon of the Holy Light.

sections.t: A Matter of Honor and Exile
p: Following the Second War, Tirion governed the region of Hearthglen from Mardenholde Keep with his wife Karandra and young son Taelan. His reign ended when he encountered an aged orc warrior named Eitrigg living as a hermit. Recognizing the veteran's deep honor, Tirion gave his word to protect him. When Alliance authorities discovered Eitrigg, Tirion fought his own countrymen to uphold his oath. For this treason against the Alliance of Lordaeron, Tirion was stripped of his nobility, excommunicated by the Silver Hand, and banished into exile; Uther spared his wife and son from the sentence.
